description: This file contains React components for the marketing section of a web application, including header navigation, hero section, statistics, and footer, with styling and interactivity.

methods.name: MarketingNav
methods.description: Top navigation component for the landing page with links to different sections and login/signup buttons.

methods.name: NavLink
methods.description: A helper component for styled navigation links with hover underline animation.

methods.name: MarketingHero
methods.description: Hero section component highlighting features, with text, call-to-actions, and a demo library overview.

methods.name: Stat
methods.description: Displays a statistic with an icon, label, and value.

methods.name: MarketingFooter
methods.description: Footer component for marketing pages with branding, links, and copyright info.
